extracted.name: Double Chocolate Mint Cookies
extracted.description: This double chocolate mint chip cookie recipe is quick and easy to make. The semisweet chocolate chips are always a hit with kids and adults alike!
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Cream together, butter, sugar and eggs. Mix in remaining ingredients. Blend well.
Drop mixture by teaspoon onto a cookie sheet. Bake for 8 or 9 minutes. Cookies will be soft. Cool for about 1 minute on a cookie sheet; then place on a wire rack to completely cool.
